title: An Analysis of Research in Software Engineering: Assessment and Trends
motivation: 现有软件工程评估存在样本小、关键词主观、评分规则忽略领导角色等问题
problem_framing: 通过构建综合评估规则(C rule)实现更合理的学者、机构和国家排名
key_insight: 区分第一/通讯作者与其他作者角色,并根据CCF分级对不同出版物赋分
method_signature: 自动化从EI Compendex采集数据,按C rule计算评分并拟合幂律分布
evaluation_criteria: 基于基本分(first/correspond author拿全分,其他作者拿一半)和CCF等级加权
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 九成顶尖学者的领导力得分低于参考线,表明软件工程领域对通讯作者标注不够重视
evidence_for_taste: most leading scholars do not attach much weight to the status of corresponding author
only the first institution named on a paper receives the basic score for its leadership
数据 errors have hardly any impact on the Top 15 ranking results
it is very hard to reach a widely recognized consensus on such an assessment
the prior studies... have been questioned by some critics
thinking_moves: 先指出前人方法的三个缺陷,再针对性提出改进
用幂律分布证明长尾数据对排名影响极小,增强结果的鲁棒性
通过组合'综合分'与'领导力分'对比揭示隐藏的学术行为模式
